mechanism_narrative: A higher unemployment rate (UNRATE) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as elevated joblessness reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth expectations, which is a consistent empirical pattern across business cycles.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE is above 5.0%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.25% signals an aggressive monetary easing policy that lowers discount rates and stimulates equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.25, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 7.0% indicates a severe labor market downturn that depresses consumer confidence and corporate investment, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 7.0, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weakness in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a broad-based economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced business activity and consumer demand.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 650 AND INDPRO < 105, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 7.0%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns as persistent joblessness erodes household income and spending power, which is a characteristic pattern of deep recessions.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 7.0 and the regime is active, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index 2017=100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 210) signals a deflationary risk that prompts central bank intervention, boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL < 210, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Weak retail sales (RSAFS < 350000) indicate a slowdown in consumer spending, which is a leading indicator of economic weakness and results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS < 350000, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.
